events.body:
## Context

`scripts/actions/welcome.mjs` posts on every enrollment or course issue and links to `.../blob/main/contributing.html` (the file is `_pages/contributing.html`, published at `/contributing/`), `${PROJECT_URL}/discussions` and a wiki that doesn't exist. `labelsToAdd` has no test.

## What to do

1. Point the links at `https://university.owaspblt.org/contributing/`, `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/discussions` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`; drop the wiki and "star" lines.
2. Add a `node --test` file for `labelsToAdd` and each `MODES[*].message` and add it to the blt-university row in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every URL in the messages resolves
- [ ] New tests pass in CI

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-university
```

---
Size: **S** · good first issue. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
